professionalSummary.text: Accountable for end‑to‑end quality of the store‑task application, ensuring releases meet store operational standards before deployment.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained the automated test suite (Appium) for the handheld fleet, adding offline‑sync scenarios after a store outage.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran pilot‑store test rounds with store staff in three pilot stores before each release, recording outcomes and escalating blocking defects.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared release readiness summaries for the store systems manager, coordinating scope decisions with the development lead and securing sign‑off.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Prepared the release readiness summary for the store systems manager, who decided the test scope with the development lead and gave the sign-off for the release to go to stores."

experienceHighlights.text: Authored release notes for store operations, documenting known limitations and hand‑over items for the support desk.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Wrote the release notes for store operations, listing known limitations (the task-photo feature needed the newer device model) and the hand-over items for the store support desk."
